rationale: Builds on the staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline instead of resetting. This keeps the winning reverse traversal, decoder-output anchor, and quant-aware endgame, but splits tail recurrence into an earlier higher-floor carry curriculum and a slightly delayed write curriculum. The hypothesis is that in the 600s Mac-mini regime, stabilizing anchor reuse before letting recurrent block writes grow should improve final int8 roundtrip behavior without adding compile churn, shape changes, or meaningful artifact-size risk.
title: Lagged Tail Recurrence Write Curriculum
